questions.question: A service that enables you to manage access to AWS services and resources securely by creating and managing users, groups, roles, and policies that define what actions identities can perform.

A managed service that makes it easy to create and control the encryption keys used to encrypt your data. It integrates with most AWS services and provides centralized key management with audit logging.

A web application firewall that protects your web applications and APIs against common web exploits such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS) that could affect availability or compromise security.

A service that helps you protect access to your applications and IT resources by enabling you to easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets throughout their lifecycle.
A service that lets you easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private SSL/TLS certificates for use with AWS services and your internal connected resources.

A vulnerability management service that continually scans your AWS workloads — including EC2 instances, Lambda functions, and container images — for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.
A threat detection service that continuously monitors your AWS accounts and workloads using machine learning, anomaly detection, and integrated threat intelligence to identify malicious activity.
A fully managed identity service that adds user authentication and authorization to your web and mobile applications, allowing users to sign in directly or through social identity providers.
A data security service that uses machine learning to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data such as PII stored in Amazon S3.
A managed DDoS protection service that safeguards applications on AWS. It provides always-on detection and automatic inline mitigations to minimize application downtime and latency.
A cloud security posture management service that aggregates security findings from multiple AWS services and partner solutions into a single dashboard for a comprehensive view of your security state.
A security management service that lets you centrally configure and manage firewall rules across your accounts and applications in AWS Organizations, ensuring consistent policy enforcement.
A stateful managed network firewall service for your VPC that provides fine-grained control over network traffic using stateful rules, domain-based filtering, and intrusion prevention.
A managed service that provides dedicated hardware security modules in the cloud, allowing you to generate and use your own encryption keys with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 validated hardware.

A security investigation service that uses machine learning to automatically collect log data and conduct security investigations, helping you analyze, identify, and quickly get to the root cause of security findings.
